arabic_text: اللَّهُمَّ هَذَا يَوْمٌ مُبَارَكٌ مَيْمُونٌ وَ الْمُسْلِمُونَ فِيهِ مُجْتَمِعُونَ فِي أَقْطَارِ أَرْضِكَ،
transliteration: allāhumma hādhā yawmun mubārakun maymūnun wa al-muslimūna fīhi mujtamiʿūna fī aqṭāri arḍika
english_text: O God, this is a blessed and fortunate day, within which the Muslims are gathered in the quarters of Thy earth.

arabic_text: يَشْهَدُ السَّائِلُ مِنْهُمْ وَ الطَّالِبُ وَ الرَّاغِبُ وَ الرَّاهِبُ وَ أَنْتَ النَّاظِرُ فِي حَوَائِجِهِمْ
transliteration: yashhadu al-sā'ilu minhum wa al-ṭālibu wa al-rāghibu wa al-rāhibu wa anta alnāẓiru fī ḥawāʾijihim
english_text: Among them are present the asker, the seeker, the beseecher, the fearful, while Thou art looking upon their needs.

arabic_text: فَأَسْأَلُكَ بِجُودِكَ وَ كَرَمِكَ وَ هَوَانِ مَا سَأَلْتُكَ عَلَيْكَ
transliteration: fa-as'aluka bi-joodika wa karamika wa hawani ma sa'alutaka 'alayk
english_text: So I ask Thee by Thy munificence and generosity and easy upon Thee is what I ask Thee!

arabic_text: أَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ وَ أَسْأَلُكَ اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّنَا بِأَنَّ لَكَ الْمُلْكَ وَ لَكَ الْحَمْدَ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، الْحَلِيمُ الْكَرِيمُ الْحَنَّانُ الْمَنَّانُ ذُو الْجَلَالِ وَ الْإِكْرَامِ، بَدِيعُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَ الْأَرْضِ،
transliteration: an tuṣalliya ʿalā muḥammadin wa ālihi wa as'aluka allahumma rabbana bi-anna laka al-mulka wa laka al-hamda lā ilāha illā anta, al-ḥalīmu al-karīmu al-ḥannānu al-mannānu dhū al-jalāl wa al-ikrām, badīʿu al-samāwāt wa al-ʾarḍ
english_text: - that Thou blessest Muhammad and his Household And I ask Thee, O God, our Lord -for Thine is the kingdom and Thine is the praise there is no god but Thou,the Clement, the Generous,the All-loving, the All-kind, Possessor of majesty and munificence,Originator of the heavens and the earth

arabic_text: ، مَهْمَا قَسَمْتَ بَيْنَ عِبَادِكَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ مِنْ خَيْرٍ أَوْ عَافِيَةٍ أَوْ بَرَكَةٍ أَوْ هُدًى أَوْ عَمَلٍ بِطَاعَتِكَ ،أَوْ خَيْرٍ تَمُنُّ بِهِ عَلَيْهِمْ تَهْدِيهِمْ بِهِ إِلَيْكَ أَوْ تَرْفَعُ لَهُمْ عِنْدَكَ دَرَجَةً
transliteration: , ma hm a qasamta bayna ʿib a dik al-muʾminin min khayrin aw ʿāfiyah aw barakah aw hudan aw ʿamalin bi-ṭāʿatika 'aw khayrin tamunnu bihi 'alayhim tahdiyhim bihi 'ilayka aw tarfaʿu lahum ʿindaka darajah
english_text: whenever Thou apportionest among Thy faithful servants good, well being, blessing, guidance, works in obedience to Thee, or good through which Thou art kind to them by guiding them to Thee, or raisest them up a degree with Thee,

arabic_text: ، أَوْ تُعْطِيهِمْ بِهِ خَيْراً مِنْ خَيْرِ الدُّنْيَا وَ الْآخِرَةِ .أَنْ تُوَفِّرَ حَظِّي وَ نَصِيبِي مِنْهُ
transliteration: , ʾaw tuʿṭīhim bihi khayran min khayri al-dunyā wa al-ākhirah ʾan tuwaffira ḥazẓī wa naṣībī minhu
english_text: or givest them the good of this world or the next, that Thou givest me amply my share and allotment of it.

arabic_text: وَ أَسْأَلُكَ اللَّهُمَّ بِأَنَّ ,لَكَ الْمُلْكَ وَ الْحَمْدَ
transliteration: wa as'aluka allahumma bi-anna.. laka al-mulk wa al-hamd
english_text: And I ask Thee, O God - for Thine is the kingdom and the praise;

arabic_text: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ أَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ عَبْدِكَ وَ رَسُولِكَ وَ حَبِيبِكَ وَ صِفْوَتِكَ
transliteration: lā ʾilāha ʾillā anta an tuṣalliya ʿalā muḥammadin ʿabdika wa rasulika wa ḥabībika wa ṣifwatika
english_text: there is no god but Thou - that Thou blessest Muhammad Thy servant and Thy messenger, Thy beloved and Thy selected friend,

arabic_text: ,وَ خِيَرَتِكَ مِنْ خَلْقِكَ وَ عَلَى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ الْأَبْرَارِ الطَّاهِرِينَ الْأَخْيَارِ ,صَلَاةً لَا يَقْوَى عَلَى إِحْصَائِهَا إِلَّا أَنْتَ وَ أَنْ تُشْرِكَنَا فِي
transliteration: wa khayrati-ka min khalqi-ka wa ʿalā āli muḥammad al-abrār al-ṭāhirīn al-akhyār ṣalātan lā yaqwā ʿalā iḥṣāʾihā illā anta wa an tushrikana fi
english_text: Thy chosen from among Thy creation, and the Household of Muhammad, the pious, the pure, the chosen, with a blessing no one has strength to count but Thou, that Thou associatest us with

arabic_text: صَالِحِ مَنْ دَعَاكَ فِي هَذَا الْيَوْمِ مِنْ عِبَادِكَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ ،يَا رَبَّ الْعَالَمِينَ ,وَ أَنْ تَغْفِرَ لَنَا وَ لَهُمْ
transliteration: ṣāliḥi man daʿāka fī hādhā al-yawm min ʿibādika al-muʾminīn yā rabba al-ʿālamīn wa an taghfira lana wa lahum
english_text: the most righteous of those who supplicate Thee today of Thy faithful servants - O Lord of the worlds!— and that Thou forgivest us and them!

arabic_text: .إِنَّكَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْ‏ءٍ قَدِيرٌ
transliteration: ʾinnaka ʿalā kulli shay'in qadīr
english_text: "Surely Thou art powerful over everything" (3:26).

arabic_text: اللَّهُمَّ إِلَيْكَ تَعَمَّدْتُ بِحَاجَتِي وَ بِكَ أَنْزَلْتُ الْيَوْمَ فَقْرِي ،وَ فَاقَتِي وَ مَسْكَنَتِي وَ إِنِّي بِمَغْفِرَتِكَ وَ رَحْمَتِكَ أَوْثَقُ مِنِّي بِعَمَلِي
transliteration: allahumma ilayka taʿammadtu bihajati wa bika anzaltu al-yawma faqri wa faqatī wa maskanatī wa inni bimaghfiratika wa rahmatika awthaqu minni biamali
english_text: O God, toward Thee I aim with my need and before Thee today I set my poverty, my neediness, my misery, for I have more trust in Thy forgiveness and Thy mercy than in my own works.

arabic_text: وَ لَمَغْفِرَتُكَ وَ رَحْمَتُكَ أَوْسَعُ مِنْ ذُنُوبِي
transliteration: wa lamaghfiratuka wa rahmatuka awsau min dhunubi
english_text: Thy forgiveness and Thy mercy are vaster than my sins.

arabic_text: فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ ، وَ تَوَلَّ قَضَاءَ كُلِّ حَاجَةٍ هِيَ لِي بِقُدْرَتِكَ عَلَيْهَا ، وَ تَيْسِيرِ ذَلِكَ عَلَيْكَ
transliteration: faṣalli ʿalā muḥammadin wa āli muḥammadin wa tawalla qadha'a kulli hajah hiya li bi-qudratika 'alayha , wa taysīri dhālika ʿalayka
english_text: So bless Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad, and attend to the accomplishment of every need of mine through Thy power over it, its easiness for Thee,

arabic_text: وَ بِفَقْرِي إِلَيْكَ وَ غِنَاكَ عَنِّي
transliteration: wa bi-faqri ilayka wa ghināka ʿannī
english_text: my poverty toward Thee, and Thy freedom from need for me!

arabic_text: ، فَإِنِّي لَمْ أُصِبْ خَيْراً قَطُّ إِلَّا مِنْكَ ، وَ لَمْ يَصْرِفْ عَنِّي سُوءاً قَطُّ أَحَدٌ غَيْرُكَ وَ لَا أَرْجُو لِأَمْرِ آخِرَتِي وَ دُنْيَايَ سِوَاكَ
transliteration: fa'inni lam usib khayran qattu illa minka wa lam yasrif ʿanni suʾan qattu aḥadun ghayruka wa lā arjū li-amri ākhiratī wa dunyāyā siwāka
english_text: I will come upon no good whatsoever unless through Thee, no one other than Thou will turn any evil away from me, and I have hope in none but Thee for my affair in the next world and in this world.

arabic_text: اللَّهُمَّ مَنْ تَهَيَّأَ وَ تَعَبَّأَ وَ أَعَدَّ وَ اسْتَعَدَّ لِوِفَادَةٍ إِلَى مَخْلُوقٍ رَجَاءَ رِفْدِهِ وَ نَوَافِلِهِ وَ طَلَبَ نَيْلِهِ وَ جَائِزَتِهِ
transliteration: allāhumma man tahayyā' wa ta'abbā'ah wa aʿadda wa istaʿadda li-wifādatin ilā makhluqin rajā'a rifdihī wa nawāfilihī wa ṭalaba naylihī wa jā'izatihī
english_text: O God, if anyone has ever arranged, made ready, prepared, and drawn himself up to be received by a creature in hope of his support and awards,

arabic_text: فَإِلَيْكَ يَا مَوْلَايَ كَانَتِ الْيَوْمَ تَهْيِئَتِي وَ تَعْبِئَتِي وَ إِعْدَادِي وَ اسْتِعْدَادِي رَجَاءَ عَفْوِكَ وَ رِفْدِكَ
transliteration: fa'ilayka ya mawlaya kānatil yawma tahyiʾatī wa taʿbiʾatī wa-iʿdādī wa-istiʿdādī rajāʾa ʿafwik(a) wa rifdik(a)
english_text: then today toward Thee, my Master, is my arrangement, my making ready, my preparation, and my drawing up in hope of Thy pardon and support

arabic_text: وَ طَلَبَ نَيْلِكَ وَ جَائِزَتِكَ
transliteration: wa ṭalaba naylika wa jā'izatika
english_text: and in seeking to attain to Thee and Thy prize.

arabic_text: اللَّهُمَّ فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَ لَا تُخَيِّبِ الْيَوْمَ ذَلِكَ مِنْ رَجَائِي،
transliteration: allāhumma faṣalli ʿalā muḥammadin wa āli muḥammadin wa lā tukhayyibi al-yawma dhālika min rajā'ī
english_text: O God, so bless Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad and disappoint not my hope in that today!

arabic_text: يَا مَنْ لَا يُحْفِيهِ سَائِلٌ وَ لَا يَنْقُصُهُ نَائِلٌ
transliteration: yā man lā yuḥfīhī sāʾilun wa lā yanqusuhu nā'ilun
english_text: O He who is not troubled by those who ask and diminished by those who attain their desire!

arabic_text: فَإِنِّي لَمْ آتِكَ ثِقَةً مِنِّي بِعَمَلٍ صَالِحٍ قَدَّمْتُهُ وَ لَا شَفَاعَةِ مَخْلُوقٍ رَجَوْتُهُ إِلَّا شَفَاعَةَ مُحَمَّدٍ وَ أَهْلِ بَيْتِهِ
transliteration: fa'inni lam atika thiqahtan minnee bi'amalin saalihin qaddamtu-hu walā shafāʿati makhlooqin rajawtuhu illā shafāʿata muḥammadin wa ahl baytih
english_text: I come not before Thee trusting in a righteous work I have sent ahead, nor in the intercession of any creature in whom I have hope, except the intercession of Muhammad and the Folk of his House

arabic_text: عَلَيْهِ وَ عَلَيْهِمْ سَلَامُكَ
transliteration: ʿalayhi wa ʿalayhim salāmuka
english_text: (upon him and upon them be Thy peace).

arabic_text: أَتَيْتُكَ مُقِرّاً بِالْجُرْمِ وَ الْإِسَاءَةِ إِلَى نَفْسِي
transliteration: ataytuka muqirran biljurm wal'isaaiati ilaa nafsi
english_text: I come to Thee admitting sin and evildoing toward myself.

arabic_text: أَتَيْتُكَ أَرْجُو عَظِيمَ عَفْوِكَ الَّذِي عَفَوْتَ بِهِ عَنِ الْخَاطِئِينَ ثُمَّ لَمْ يَمْنَعْكَ طُولُ عُكُوفِهِمْ عَلَى عَظِيمِ الْجُرْمِ أَنْ عُدْتَ عَلَيْهِمْ بِالرَّحْمَةِ وَ الْمَغْفِرَةِ
transliteration: ataytuka arjuu `aẓeema `afwik alla th ee ʿafawta bihi ʿani al-khāṭiʾīn thumma lam yamnaʿka ṭūlu ʿukūfihim ʿalā ʿaẓīmil jurm 'an 'udta 'alayhim biraḥmati wal-maghfirah
english_text: I come to Thee hoping for Thy abounding pardon through which Thou hast pardoned the offenders, while their long persistence in dreadful sin did not prevent Thee from returning toward them with mercy and forgiveness!

arabic_text: فَيَا مَنْ رَحْمَتُهُ وَاسِعَةٌ وَ عَفْوُهُ عَظِيمٌ
transliteration: fayā man raḥmatuhu wāsiʿah wa ʿafwuhu ʿaẓīm
english_text: O He whose mercy is wide and whose pardon is abounding!

arabic_text: ، يَا عَظِيمُ يَا عَظِيمُ
transliteration: yā ʿaẓīmu, yā ʿaẓīmu
english_text: O All-mighty! O All-mighty!

arabic_text: يَا كَرِيمُ يَا كَرِيمُ
transliteration: yā karīmu, yā karīmu
english_text: O All-generous! O All-generous!

arabic_text: صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَ عُدْ عَلَيَّ بِرَحْمَتِكَ وَ تَعَطَّفْ عَلَيَّ بِفَضْلِكَ وَ تَوَسَّعْ عَلَيَّ بِمَغْفِرَتِكَ
transliteration: ṣalli ʿalā muḥammadin wa āli muḥammadin. wa ʿud ʿalayya biraḥmatika wa taʿattaf ʿalayya bifadlika wa tawassal ʿalayya bimaghfiratika
english_text: Bless Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad, return toward me through Thy mercy, be tender toward me through Thy bounty, and spread out Thy forgiveness upon me!

arabic_text: . اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّ هَذَا الْمَقَامَ لِخُلَفَائِكَ وَ أَصْفِيَائِكَ وَ مَوَاضِعَ أُمَنَائِكَ فِي الدَّرَجَةِ الرَّفِيعَةِ الَّتِي اخْتَصَصْتَهُمْ بِهَا قَدِ ابْتَزُّوهَا
transliteration: allāhumma innahā al-maqāma li-khulafā'ika wa asfiyā'ika wa mawāḍiʿa ʾumanāʾika fī al-darajah al-rafīʿah allatī ikhtashaṣtahum bihā qadi ibtazzuha
english_text: O God, this station belongs to Thy vicegerents, Thy chosen, while the places of Thy trusted ones in the elevated degree which Thou hast singled out for them have been forcibly stripped!
